bullets.text: The Bucks are 1-16 after 13 straight losses, the league's deepest slide by a wide margin.
The Spurs, Lakers and 76ers are all 14-3, with the Spurs holding the NBA's best point margin at +11.9 per game.
The Heat and 76ers are winning on thin margins, +20 and +50, while the Celtics are +155 but only 11-6 after four straight losses.
